Changes from compiler66 beyond the version are enumerated per emitted Wasm function and restore compiler64 bodies after the rejected fusion was removed. All refusals remain equal. This is byte equivalence evidence, not a performance or execution claim.

metadataNormalization.wasm: Decode base64, parse section lengths and names, and require exactly one custom section named a0 whose entire payload is the exact expected compiler version. Replace only that same-length payload. Preserve every other byte, including section order, lengths, code and other metadata.
metadataNormalization.test: The committed profile test continues to compare complete raw emitted-text hashes. No normalization was added to that test.
